references.text: The same promise that God shows mercy to thousands of generations of those who love him and keep his commandments
Parallel text in Deuteronomy repeating the Ten Commandments, including the promise of mercy to a thousand generations
God reveals himself to Moses and describes his character as rich in mercy (חֶסֶד) to a thousand generations
Moses quotes God's self-revelation about his mercy when he prays for the people
Promise that God will keep his covenant and show mercy to those who keep his commandments
Nehemiah calls upon the great and awesome God who keeps his covenant and shows mercy to those who love him
Daniel prays to God who keeps his covenant and shows mercy to those who love him and keep his commandments
God's mercy (חֶסֶד) endures from everlasting to everlasting over those who fear him and keep his commandments
A prayer that God would turn to the psalmist and show mercy, as he does to those who love his name
Jesus links love for him with keeping his commandments, reflecting the pattern in Exodus 20:6
Whoever has Jesus' commandments and keeps them is the one who loves him—and will be loved by the Father
Love for God is shown by keeping his commandments, and his commandments are not burdensome
All things work together for good for those who love God
